items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring injury.

items.implication: Houston WR1 out; elevated TE/WR2 opportunity vs IND.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) will not practice Friday, listed doubtful vs Broncos; McVay expects return next week vs Eagles barring setback. No IR consideration.

items.opportunity: Adams routes/targets; TE/Ferguson secondary

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) will not be placed on IR; surgery not on table. Week-to-week, aiming return ASAP. Mariota starts vs SEA.

items.implication: Positive for ROS; shorter absence than feared. Mariota short-term.
items.opportunity: Mariota spot-start; McLaurin usage with backup QB

items.text: With Dowdle out, Steelers RB coach says Warren will lead the group and get breathers as needed. Expect PS Homer and rookie Heidenreich as backups. Vertical game failing for Rodgers; more checkdowns to Warren likely.
items.why: Coach comment + Dowdle OUT confirmation; routes/targets context.
items.implication: Warren clear lead if active (Q shoulder); high checkdown volume.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps, carries, targets for Warren

items.text: Packers first game without Jayden Reed (neck/back): on 55 Love dropbacks, Watson 45 routes, Golden 44, Moore 27. Watson & Golden combined 48% of Love targets so far.
items.why: TNF route data post-Reed absence.
items.implication: Watson/Golden clear primary WRs; strong opportunity.
items.opportunity: High route participation and target share

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (core); only 5 games in 3 seasons. Pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly to lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.why: Reaggravated groin; Berry/ETR notes.
items.implication: Hubbard clear RB1 for CAR.
items.opportunity: Full lead back snaps/carries for Hubbard

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 30% routes targeted / 28% target share last week sans Collins. IND allows 4th-most yards to TEs.
items.why: Usage spike confirmed with Collins out again + matchup.
items.implication: TE1 streamer/start.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets with Collins OUT

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% route participation this season, six targets (8% share) through three games. TPRR last two years: 33% with London off, 17% with London on.

items.implication: Fade Pitts while London healthy; low opportunity.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.

items.implication: Strong start vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86). PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.

items.implication: RB1/2 play this week.
items.opportunity: Touches + receiving work

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards. LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.

items.implication: Watson/Golden elevated WR2/3; Berry also loves Watson.
items.opportunity: High route participation + target share/red-zone without Reed.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz (@IND: 28% share sans Collins, Colts allow 4th-most TE yds), Chris Olave (vs LV: double-digit tgts, high aDOT), Christian Watson (vs ATL: WR8 util, 38% RZ).
items.why: Utilization/matchup data; Collins out boosts Schultz.
items.implication: Start Schultz TE1, Olave/Watson WR2/flex.
items.opportunity: Schultz routes/targets sans Collins; Olave air yards; Watson RZ.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps), Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest WR pts allowed, low team total).
items.why: Role/snap share + matchup data; Henderson out-touched post-fumble.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; Henderson rising but Stevenson still ranked ahead by Berry.
items.opportunity: Low for Etienne/Stevenson; McLaurin suppressed by SEA D + Mariota.
items.conflict: ETR lists Etienne IN but role limited.

items.text: 10 Facts: Schultz 30% routes/28% share sans Collins; London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds avg with Penix (12 gms); Brooks IR pushes Hubbard lead (AJ Dillon backup).
items.why: Per-player utilization/historical avgs; Brooks IR confirmed.
items.implication: Schultz must-start; London smash with Penix; Hubbard RB2.
items.opportunity: Schultz targets sans Collins; London high share; Hubbard full carries.

items.text: Week 3 projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling proj at 44.0 (avg top 25th %ile sim outcomes).
items.why: ETR sim ceiling record; updates for news.
items.implication: Elite weekly upside; start confidently.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry share in Lions offense.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets/8% share through 3 games; TPRR 33% sans London vs 17% with.
items.why: Route/target share data; London on-field suppresses.
items.implication: Fade Pitts; London dominates opportunity.
items.opportunity: London high target share/routes; Pitts limited even when active.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry (vs DAL: highest rush prop, DAL 30th rush D), Chase Brown (@PIT: 20+ touches/15% tgts both games), Brock Purdy (vs ARI: high total, ARI secondary depleted).
items.why: Matchup/utilization; volume locked.
items.implication: Strong starts; Henry smash, Brown RB2, Purdy QB1.
items.opportunity: Henry carries vs weak run D; Brown snap/target share.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Week 3 vs Broncos (hip/groin); did not practice all week. McVay: more unlikely than likely; expects return next week vs Eagles barring setback.
items.why: Hip/groin; full DNP week; McVay comments
items.implication: Davante Adams and other Rams WRs elevated targets/routes; sit Nacua
items.opportunity: Adams target share spike (prior 42% sans Nacua noted by Levitan)

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday vs Seahawks. Not on IR; week-to-week, aiming return ASAP after specialists; no surgery.
items.why: Elbow dislocation; imaging/specialists; positive long-term
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; McLaurin still viable but tough SEA matchup; sit Daniels
items.opportunity: Mariota game script; McLaurin 25% share historically w/ Mariota

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at Indianapolis.
items.why: Hamstring injury; ruled out Friday
items.implication: Dalton Schultz elevated (30% routes/28% share prior sans Collins); sit Collins
items.opportunity: Schultz TE upside vs Colts (4th-most TE yards allowed)

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs Bengals. Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach: Warren will lead group, get breathers to stay fresh.
items.why: Toe; walking boot earlier; coach comments on rotation
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdowns from Rodgers (vertical failing); Homer/Heidenreich backups
items.opportunity: Warren volume spike, third-down/ dual-threat

items.implication: Start Nabers confidently; Giants offense boost post-Dart

items.implication: GTD; Ravens WR depth if out

items.why: Glute; cleared Friday
items.implication: Full Seahawks offense; Jadarian Price also IN per ETR
items.opportunity: Seahawks pass game stability

items.text: With Dowdle out, expecting Jaylen Warren to lead; vertical pass game failing for Rodgers so spam Warren checkdowns. Practice squad Homer + rookie Heidenreich as backups.

items.implication: Strong Warren start/upgrade; checkdown volume
